claims.text: COPD: for repeated exacerbations or symptoms despite optimal bronchodilators;
claims.quote: They are indicated for patients who have repeated exacerbations or symptoms despite optimal bronchodilator therapy.
claims.locator: Pharmacotherapy for Stable COPD › Inhaled corticosteroids (glucocorticoids)

claims.text: most effective with eosinophils ≥ 150/mcL. May need to de-escalate if pneumonia develops or no response; with eosinophils ≥ 300/mcL, de-escalation is more likely to cause an exacerbation.
claims.quote: ICS is most effective in patients with eosinophilia ≥ 150/mcL (≥ 0.15 × 109/L). May need to de-escalate ICS if the patient develops pneumonia or does not respond to treatment. In patients with eosinophilia ≥ 300 mcL (≥ 0.30 × 109/L), de-escalation is more likely to cause an exacerbation.

claims.text: Fluticasone is a CYP3A4 substrate: strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (eg, ketoconazole) raise exposure; use caution.
claims.quote: Fluticasone furoate is a substrate of CYP3A4. Concomitant administration of the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor ketoconazole increases the systemic exposure to fluticasone furoate. Caution should be exercised when considering the coadministration of ARNUITY ELLIPTA with ketoconazole and other known strong CYP3A4 inhibitors

claims.text: Acute overdose rarely needs more than observation;
claims.quote: overdosage of fluticasone furoate is unlikely to require any treatment other than observation.
Chronic overdosage may result in signs/symptoms of hypercorticism
